title: OrgChartGenerator teams file (v1)
description: Structure of an organization: nested Teams containing Positions. Strict: unknown keys are errors at every level.

org.description: Name of the organization. Forms the root segment of every Path.

version.description: Format version. A file of a later version will not validate against this schema.

teamMap.description: Teams keyed by name. A name may not contain '/', which joins Path segments.

team.description: A Team. May contain sub-Teams, Positions, both, or neither.

position.description: A single seat within a Team. Vacant when 'occupant' is absent.

role.description: The Role this Position is a seat for, e.g. 'EngineeringManager'. May not contain '/'. Need not be unique within a Team.

occupant.description: Email of the Employee filling this Position. Not checked against the employees file.
